sourceBytes.rule: Every promoted raw WAV must match the exact relative path and SHA-256 bound in the technical receipt and normalized human review.

rules: Materialization is the explicit state-promoting operation and requires a complete positive normalized human Foley review.
Eligibility is recomputed from reviewer identity, provenance rights, all take/cue decisions and typed listening checks; the tool never trusts a manually edited ready flag alone.
Raw WAV bytes are copied unchanged. No trim, denoise, resample, EQ, gain, layering, looping edit, compression or transcoding occurs here.
source-approved does not imply derived-master-approved, Unity-integrated, Quest-approved or release-approved.
Any later edit creates a new file identity and must follow the derived-master technical + repeated-human-listening gate.
